title: Re: "Review entire Meridian codebase for errors"
summary: Meridian codebase review (task: review-entire-meridian-codebase-for-errors-184a) found no critical code-execution vulnerabilities, but 1 high, 6 medium, 3 low issues. Highest priority: sidebar favicon fallbacks leak visited domains to Google (components/sidebar.js) — a Chrome Web Store privacy blocker; recommend switching to Chrome's local /_favicon/ endpoint and adding privacy disclosures. Medium issues include broken lane rename keyboard handling, stale async sidebar search results, stale accent-color analysis, stale workspace assignment after native tab grouping, disabled search sources still being queried, and possibly over-broad manifest permissions. Low issues: stale web-search popup results, unvalidated homepage URLs, non-focusable sidebar rows. Review excluded background.js, utils/*, and meridian-extension/, and no tests were run, so it's incomplete. User asked for recommendations (ordered fix plan) and had 8 dependency-linked tasks created, with a recommended run order (#1–#4 parallel, then #5/#6, #7, #8). User also requested "Search anything" input font size changed from 16px to 15px (done, both root and packaged CSS). Later, user's PC slept, stalling the in-progress audit task; Tasker's watchdog auto-restarted it at 8:36 PM — now 3 of 5 steps done, no intervention needed.
